title: "01 sncRNA Compare - Radar, Alluvial, Bar and Length"
output: pdf_document

```{r init, include=FALSE, pandora_stage="prepare"}
PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE <- get0("PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE", inherits = TRUE,
  ifnotfound = Sys.getenv("PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE", unset = "describe"))
stopifnot(PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE %in% c("describe", "differential", "enrichment"))
initialize_profile_comparison_module(
  environment(),
  SNC_COMPARE_FIG,
  SNC_COMPARE_TAB,
  "01_sncRNA_compare",
  c(
    "01_sector_radar",
    "02_length_distribution",
    "03_bar_sncRNA",
    "04_alluvial_sncRNA",
    "05_mapping_statistics",
    "06_sequence_type",
    "07_company_landscape",
    "02_sector_radar",
    "03_length_distribution",
    "04_trend"
  )
)
PANDORA_CAN_PCA <- nrow(sample_info) >= 3L
pandora_group_n <- table(as.character(sample_info$Group))
PANDORA_CAN_COMPARE <- length(pandora_group_n) >= 2L && all(pandora_group_n >= 2L)
write_csv_safe(tibble(
  AnalysisStage = PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE,
  AnalysisScope = get0("analysis_scope", inherits = TRUE, ifnotfound = "all"),
  LibraryN = nrow(sample_info), GroupN = length(pandora_group_n),
  PCAApplicable = PANDORA_CAN_PCA, GroupComparisonApplicable = PANDORA_CAN_COMPARE
), "analysis_stage_status.csv")

```

```{r build-sncrna-trend-data, include=FALSE, pandora_stage="prepare", eval=TRUE}
trend_all_sample_df <- summary_top %>%
  mutate(TrendCategory = length_category_from_class(Class)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(TrendCategory)) %>%
  group_by(Sample, Group, TrendCategory) %>%
  summarise(Reads = sum(Reads, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Sample, Group) %>%
  mutate(Percent = group_percent(Reads)) %>%
  ungroup()

trend_all_df <- trend_all_sample_df %>%
  summarise_group_mean_percent("TrendCategory")

trend_major_categories <- c("rsRNA", "tsRNA", "piRNA", "miRNA", if (ENDO_ENABLED) "endo-siRNA")
trend_extra_categories <- trend_all_df %>%
  filter(!TrendCategory %in% trend_major_categories) %>%
  group_by(TrendCategory) %>%
  summarise(TotalPercent = sum(Percent, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(TotalPercent > 0) %>%
  arrange(desc(TotalPercent)) %>%
  pull(TrendCategory)

trend_category_levels <- c(trend_major_categories, trend_extra_categories)
trend_all_df <- trend_all_df %>%
  mutate(TrendCategory = factor(TrendCategory, levels = trend_category_levels))

trend_major_sample_df <- summary_top %>%
  filter(as.character(MainCategory) %in% trend_major_categories) %>%
  transmute(Sample, Group, TrendCategory = as.character(MainCategory), Reads) %>%
  group_by(Sample, Group, TrendCategory) %>%
  summarise(Reads = sum(Reads, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Sample, Group) %>%
  mutate(Percent = group_percent(Reads)) %>%
  ungroup()

trend_major_df <- trend_major_sample_df %>%
  summarise_group_mean_percent("TrendCategory") %>%
  mutate(TrendCategory = factor(TrendCategory, levels = trend_major_categories))

group_snc_total_tbl <- summary_top %>%
  group_by(Group) %>%
  summarise(TotalSncReads = sum(Reads, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

sample_snc_total_tbl <- sample_comp_view %>%
  group_by(Sample, Group) %>%
  summarise(TotalSncReads = sum(Reads, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

sample_comp_total_snc <- sample_comp_view %>%
  left_join(sample_snc_total_tbl, by = c("Sample", "Group")) %>%
  mutate(PercentTotalSnc = if_else(TotalSncReads > 0, 100 * Reads / TotalSncReads, 0))

group_comp_total_snc <- sample_comp_total_snc %>%
  summarise_group_mean_percent("MainCategory", percent_col = "PercentTotalSnc") %>%
  rename(PercentTotalSnc = Percent)
```

```{r sncrna-mapping-statistics, include=FALSE, pandora_stage="describe", eval=PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE == "describe"}
sample_mapping_components <- sample_comp_view %>%
  mutate(MainCategory = as.character(MainCategory)) %>%
  group_by(Sample, Group) %>%
  summarise(
    AnnotatedSncReads = sum(Reads[!MainCategory %in% c("unanno_MG", "unanno_UMG", "other")], na.rm = TRUE),
    UnannotatedGenomeMatchReads = sum(Reads[MainCategory == "unanno_MG"], na.rm = TRUE),
    UnannotatedGenomeUnmatchReads = sum(Reads[MainCategory == "unanno_UMG"], na.rm = TRUE),
    OtherReads = sum(Reads[MainCategory == "other"], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

sample_mapping_statistics <- sample_qc_table %>%
  transmute(
    Sample = as.character(Sample),
    Group = as.character(Group),
    CleanReads,
    MatchGenome,
    UnmatchGenome = pmax(CleanReads - MatchGenome, 0),
    GenomeRate
  ) %>%
  left_join(sample_mapping_components, by = c("Sample", "Group")) %>%
  mutate(
    across(c(AnnotatedSncReads, UnannotatedGenomeMatchReads, UnannotatedGenomeUnmatchReads, OtherReads), ~replace_na(.x, 0)),
    AnnotatedSncPercent = if_else(CleanReads > 0, 100 * AnnotatedSncReads / CleanReads, 0),
    UnannotatedGenomeMatchPercent = if_else(CleanReads > 0, 100 * UnannotatedGenomeMatchReads / CleanReads, 0),
    UnannotatedGenomeUnmatchPercent = if_else(CleanReads > 0, 100 * UnannotatedGenomeUnmatchReads / CleanReads, 0),
    OtherPercent = if_else(CleanReads > 0, 100 * OtherReads / CleanReads, 0),
    UnmatchGenomePercent = if_else(CleanReads > 0, 100 * UnmatchGenome / CleanReads, 0)
  )

mapping_stack_df <- sample_mapping_statistics %>%
  select(Sample, Group, AnnotatedSncPercent, UnannotatedGenomeMatchPercent, UnannotatedGenomeUnmatchPercent, OtherPercent) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = ends_with("Percent"),
    names_to = "MappingType",
    values_to = "Percent"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    MappingType = recode(
      MappingType,
      AnnotatedSncPercent = "annotated_sncRNA",
      UnannotatedGenomeMatchPercent = "unannotated_match_genome",
      UnannotatedGenomeUnmatchPercent = "unannotated_unmatch_genome",
      OtherPercent = "other"
    ),
    MappingType = factor(MappingType, levels = c("annotated_sncRNA", "unannotated_match_genome", "unannotated_unmatch_genome", "other")),
    Sample = factor(Sample, levels = as.character(sample_info$Sample)),
    Group = factor(Group, levels = group_levels)
  )

mapping_palette <- c(
  annotated_sncRNA = serum_blue,
  unannotated_match_genome = serum_green,
  unannotated_unmatch_genome = serum_orange,
  other = serum_neutral_line
)

mapping_stack_plot <- ggplot(mapping_stack_df, aes(x = Sample, y = Percent, fill = MappingType)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.72, color = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = mapping_palette, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Percent of clean reads",
    title = "Reads mapping and annotation statistics",
    fill = "Type"
  ) +
  serum_theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1), legend.position = "top")

save_plot_nested(
  mapping_stack_plot,
  "05_mapping_statistics",
  "reads_mapping_statistics.pdf",
  width = 10,
  height = 5.8,
  view = REPORT_VIEW
)
```

```{r sncrna-sequence-type, include=FALSE, pandora_stage="describe", eval=PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE == "describe"}
sequence_type_sample <- output_all %>%
  filter(!is.na(Sequence), Sequence != "") %>%
  mutate(SequenceType = factor(as.character(FeatureCategory), levels = category_levels)) %>%
  group_by(Sample, Group, SequenceType) %>%
  summarise(
    SequenceCount = n_distinct(Sequence),
    Reads = sum(Reads, na.rm = TRUE),
    RPM = sum(RPM, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Sample, Group) %>%
  mutate(SequencePercent = group_percent(SequenceCount), ReadPercent = group_percent(Reads)) %>%
  ungroup()

sequence_type_read_percent <- sequence_type_sample %>%
  summarise_group_mean_percent("SequenceType", percent_col = "ReadPercent") %>%
  select(Group, SequenceType, ReadPercent = Percent)

sequence_type_unique_percent <- sequence_type_sample %>%
  summarise_group_mean_percent("SequenceType", percent_col = "SequencePercent", reads_col = "SequenceCount") %>%
  select(Group, SequenceType, SequencePercent = Percent)

sequence_type_group <- sequence_type_sample %>%
  summarise_group_mean_rpm("SequenceType") %>%
  left_join(
    sequence_type_sample %>%
      mutate(Group = as.character(Group)) %>%
      group_by(Group, SequenceType) %>%
      summarise(SequenceCount = sum(SequenceCount, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop"),
    by = c("Group", "SequenceType")
  ) %>%
  left_join(sequence_type_read_percent, by = c("Group", "SequenceType")) %>%
  left_join(sequence_type_unique_percent, by = c("Group", "SequenceType")) %>%
  mutate(across(c(SequenceCount, ReadPercent, SequencePercent), ~replace_na(.x, 0))) %>%
  mutate(Group = factor(as.character(Group), levels = group_levels))

sequence_type_levels <- sequence_type_group %>%
  filter(SequenceCount > 0) %>%
  arrange(match(as.character(SequenceType), category_levels)) %>%
  pull(SequenceType) %>%
  as.character() %>%
  unique()

if (length(sequence_type_levels) > 0) {
  sequence_count_plot <- ggplot(sequence_type_group %>% filter(SequenceType %in% sequence_type_levels), aes(x = Group, y = SequencePercent, fill = SequenceType)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.72, color = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = category_palette, drop = FALSE) +
    labs(
      x = "Group",
      y = "Percent of unique sequences",
      title = "sncRNA sequence type composition",
      fill = "Sequence type"
    ) +
    serum_theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "top")

  read_count_plot <- ggplot(sequence_type_group %>% filter(SequenceType %in% sequence_type_levels), aes(x = Group, y = ReadPercent, fill = SequenceType)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.72, color = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = category_palette, drop = FALSE) +
    labs(
      x = "Group",
      y = "Percent of reads",
      title = "Read-weighted sncRNA sequence type composition",
      fill = "Sequence type"
    ) +
    serum_theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "top")

  save_plot_nested(
    sequence_count_plot,
    "06_sequence_type",
    "sncRNA_sequence_type_unique_sequence_percent.pdf",
    width = 9,
    height = 5.8,
    view = REPORT_VIEW
  )

  save_plot_nested(
    read_count_plot,
    "06_sequence_type",
    "sncRNA_sequence_type_read_percent.pdf",
    width = 9,
    height = 5.8,
    view = REPORT_VIEW
  )
}
```

```{r company-landscape-supplement, include=FALSE, pandora_stage="describe", eval=PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE == "describe"}
company_sample_order <- as.character(sample_info$Sample)

ensure_company_sample_columns <- function(df, leading_cols, sample_order = company_sample_order) {
  for (sample_name in sample_order) {
    if (!sample_name %in% names(df)) df[[sample_name]] <- 0
  }
  df %>% select(all_of(leading_cols), all_of(sample_order))
}

company_length_distribution_reads_wide <- length_detail_view %>%
  mutate(Class = as.character(MainCategory), Sample = as.character(Sample)) %>%
  group_by(Class, Length, Sample) %>%
  summarise(Reads = sum(Reads, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Sample, values_from = Reads, values_fill = 0) %>%
  ensure_company_sample_columns(c("Class", "Length")) %>%
  arrange(Class, Length)

company_length_distribution_rpm_wide <- length_detail_view %>%
  mutate(Class = as.character(MainCategory), Sample = as.character(Sample)) %>%
  group_by(Class, Length, Sample) %>%
  summarise(RPM = sum(RPM, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Sample, values_from = RPM, values_fill = 0) %>%
  ensure_company_sample_columns(c("Class", "Length")) %>%
  arrange(Class, Length)

company_sequence_type_reads_wide <- sequence_type_sample %>%
  mutate(SequenceType = as.character(SequenceType), Sample = as.character(Sample)) %>%
  group_by(SequenceType, Sample) %>%
  summarise(Reads = sum(Reads, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Sample, values_from = Reads, values_fill = 0) %>%
  ensure_company_sample_columns("SequenceType") %>%
  arrange(SequenceType)

company_sequence_type_unique_wide <- sequence_type_sample %>%
  mutate(SequenceType = as.character(SequenceType), Sample = as.character(Sample)) %>%
  group_by(SequenceType, Sample) %>%
  summarise(SequenceCount = sum(SequenceCount, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Sample, values_from = SequenceCount, values_fill = 0) %>%
  ensure_company_sample_columns("SequenceType") %>%
  arrange(SequenceType)

company_reads_mapping_statistics_wide <- sample_mapping_statistics %>%
  mutate(Sample = as.character(Sample)) %>%
  select(
    Sample,
    CleanReads,
    MatchGenome,
    UnmatchGenome,
    AnnotatedSncReads,
    UnannotatedGenomeMatchReads,
    UnannotatedGenomeUnmatchReads,
    OtherReads
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(-Sample, names_to = "type", values_to = "Reads") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Sample, values_from = Reads, values_fill = 0) %>%
  ensure_company_sample_columns("type") %>%
  arrange(type)

company_length_plot_df <- group_length_view %>%
  mutate(MainCategory = factor(as.character(MainCategory), levels = category_levels), Group = factor(as.character(Group), levels = group_levels)) %>%
  filter(RPM > 0, !is.na(MainCategory))

company_length_all_plot <- if (nrow(company_length_plot_df) == 0) {
  plot_note("sncRNA length distribution", "No length distribution data available.")
} else {
  ggplot(company_length_plot_df, aes(x = Length, y = RPM, color = Group, group = Group)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.75, alpha = 0.95) +
    geom_point(size = 0.85) +
    facet_wrap(~MainCategory, scales = "free_y", ncol = 4) +
    scale_color_manual(values = group_palette, drop = FALSE) +
    sncrna_length_axis() +
    labs(x = "Length (nt)", y = "RPM", title = "sncRNA length distribution across all categories") +
    serum_theme_bw() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = serum_neutral_line),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
}

save_plot_nested(
  company_length_all_plot,
  "02_length_distribution",
  "sncRNA_length_distribution_all_categories.pdf",
  width = 12,
  height = 9,
  view = REPORT_VIEW
)
```

```{r sncrna-sector-radar-compare, include=FALSE, pandora_stage="describe", eval=PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE == "describe"}
compare_pie_df <- compute_pie_tables(summary_top) %>%
  summarise_group_mean_percent("PieCategory")

radar_max <- max(c(30, if (nrow(compare_pie_df) == 0) 0 else max(compare_pie_df$Percent, na.rm = TRUE)), na.rm = TRUE)
radar_max <- max(ceiling(radar_max / 5) * 5, 30)
radar_breaks <- unique(round(seq(0, radar_max, length.out = 5), 2))

for (group_name in group_levels) {
  group_df <- compare_pie_df %>% filter(Group == group_name)
  if (nrow(group_df) == 0) next
  group_plot <- plot_sector_radar_core(
    plot_df = build_sector_radar_df(group_df %>% mutate(Sample = paste0("Group_", group_name)), radar_max = radar_max),
    title_text = paste0("sncRNA Proportion of Group ", group_name, view_title_suffix(REPORT_VIEW)),
    radar_max = radar_max,
    radar_breaks = radar_breaks
  )
  save_plot_nested(
    group_plot,
    "01_sector_radar",
    paste0("group_", safe_dir_name(group_name), ".pdf"),
    width = 8,
    height = 8,
    view = REPORT_VIEW
  )
}

shared_radar <- plot_group_sector_radar(
  prepare_group_sector_radar(
    compare_pie_df,
    radar_max = radar_max,
    sector_levels = radar_levels,
    sector_labels = radar_labels,
    bottom_anchor_category = "rsRNA",
    sector_palette = radar_sector_palette,
    value_digits = 1,
    min_value_label = 0.1
  ),
  title_text = paste0("sncRNA Proportion Across Groups", view_title_suffix(REPORT_VIEW)),
  radar_max = radar_max,
  radar_breaks = radar_breaks,
  sector_palette = radar_sector_palette,
  value_radius = 0.90,
  value_size = 1.55
)
save_plot_nested(shared_radar, "01_sector_radar", "group_compare.pdf", width = 9, height = 8.5, view = REPORT_VIEW)
```

```{r sncrna-bar-and-alluvial, include=FALSE, pandora_stage="describe", eval=PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE == "describe"}
compare_trend_overview_plots <- list(
  all_percent_alluvial = build_trend_alluvial_plot(trend_all_df, trend_category_levels, "Percent", "Alluvial plot of all classified RNA proportions across groups", "Proportion within classified RNA (%)", group_levels),
  major_percent_alluvial = build_trend_alluvial_plot(trend_major_df, trend_major_categories, "Percent", "Alluvial plot of major sncRNA proportions across groups", "Proportion within major sncRNA (%)", group_levels)
)

save_plot_nested(compare_trend_overview_plots$all_percent_alluvial, "04_alluvial_sncRNA", "all_classified_rna_percent.pdf", width = 11, height = 6.5, view = REPORT_VIEW)
save_plot_nested(compare_trend_overview_plots$major_percent_alluvial, "04_alluvial_sncRNA", "major_sncRNA_percent.pdf", width = 10, height = 5.8, view = REPORT_VIEW)

for (category_name in intersect(c("miRNA", "piRNA", "tsRNA", "rsRNA", "ysRNA", if (ENDO_ENABLED) "endo-siRNA"), category_levels)) {
  category_data <- sample_comp_total_snc %>% filter(as.character(MainCategory) == category_name)
  if (nrow(category_data) == 0) next

  percent_bar <- build_two_group_summary_bar(
    category_data,
    "PercentTotalSnc",
    paste0(category_name, " abundance across groups"),
    "Mean percent of total sncRNA per sample",
    group_levels,
    fill_palette = group_palette,
    sample_info = sample_info,
    label_digits = 1
  )

  reads_bar <- build_two_group_summary_bar(
    category_data,
    "Reads",
    paste0(category_name, " reads across groups"),
    "Mean reads per sample",
    group_levels,
    fill_palette = group_palette,
    sample_info = sample_info,
    comma_labels = TRUE,
    label_digits = 0
  )

  save_plot_nested(percent_bar, "03_bar_sncRNA", paste0(safe_dir_name(category_name), "_percent_bar.pdf"), width = 7, height = 5, view = REPORT_VIEW)
  save_plot_nested(reads_bar, "03_bar_sncRNA", paste0(safe_dir_name(category_name), "_reads_bar.pdf"), width = 7, height = 5, view = REPORT_VIEW)
}
```

```{r sncrna-length-compare, include=FALSE, pandora_stage="describe", eval=PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE == "describe"}
for (category_name in length_focus_categories) {
  merged_df <- group_length_view %>%
    filter(as.character(MainCategory) == category_name, RPM > 0) %>%
    mutate(Group = factor(as.character(Group), levels = group_levels))

  line_plot <- if (nrow(merged_df) == 0) {
    plot_note(category_name, "No length distribution data available.")
  } else {
    ggplot(merged_df, aes(x = Length, y = RPM, color = Group, group = Group)) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 0.9, alpha = 0.95) +
      geom_point(size = 0.85) +
      scale_color_manual(values = group_palette, drop = FALSE) +
      sncrna_length_axis() +
      labs(x = "Length (nt)", y = "RPM", title = NULL) +
      serum_theme_bw() +
      theme(legend.position = "top", legend.title = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
  }

  bar_plot <- if (nrow(merged_df) == 0) {
    plot_note(category_name, "No length bar-comparison data available.")
  } else {
    ggplot(merged_df, aes(x = factor(Length), y = RPM, fill = Group)) +
      geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.74), width = 0.68) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = group_palette, drop = FALSE) +
      labs(x = "Length (nt)", y = "RPM", title = NULL) +
      serum_theme_bw() +
      theme(legend.position = "none", legend.title = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
  }

  combined_plot <- build_plot_collage(
    list(line_plot, bar_plot),
    title_text = paste(category_name, "length comparison across groups"),
    cols = 1
  )
  save_plot_nested(
    combined_plot,
    "02_length_distribution",
    paste0("length_compare_", safe_dir_name(category_name), ".pdf"),
    width = 9,
    height = 10,
    view = REPORT_VIEW
  )
}
```
